# Vendored GLAD loader

These files were generated with GLAD 2.0.8 and are committed so VectorGL users
do not need Python, Jinja2, or a network connection to generate an OpenGL
loader during the build.

Generation settings:

```text
API: OpenGL Core 3.3
Generator: C/C++
Loader: enabled
Extensions: all
Reproducible: enabled
Header-only: disabled
```

Equivalent generation command:

```text
glad --api gl:core=3.3 --reproducible c --loader
```

The generated files contain their SPDX license declaration. The GLAD and
Khronos license texts are preserved in `LICENSE`.
